Vokabular.et: 18th century, learned borrowing from Latin vocabularium. By surface analysis, Vokabel + -ar.

s: A portmanteau of Völker and Abfälle.

Vokalverschiebung.et: From Vokal (“vowel”) + Verschiebung (“shift”). Further analysable as Vokal + ver- + schieben + -ung.
